snippet.title: Militsoner - New Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
A new trailer for the wonderfully bizarre escape sim, Militsoner, where every move players make is being followed by a GIANT Policeman. Anger, flatter, decieve or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive title, coming soon to Steam. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #militsoner
